name: The Deponent
title: The Deponent
text: I, {{deponent_name}}, aged about {{deponent_age}} years, {{deponent_relation}} of {{deponent_parent_name}}, resident of {{deponent_address}}, holding {{deponent_id_type}} bearing number {{deponent_id_number}}, do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath as follows:

legal_basis.note: The affidavit must state the deponent's means of knowledge
False evidence on affidavit is punishable; the corresponding provision must be confirmed against the bare Sanhita

source: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023; Civil Procedure Code, 1908
statutory_reference: Civil Procedure Code, 1908 - Order XIX Rule 3
authoring_note: The deponent must be identified well enough that the affidavit can be tied to a person - name alone is not enough, which is why age, parentage, address and an identity document are all taken. The officer administering the oath is required to satisfy themselves of identity, and an affidavit that does not record how that was done is easily attacked.
